summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of SIMIN. Backend: 20 pytest cases covering auth (login/refresh/me/invalid), role-based access (admin vs user), CRUD for machines/spareparts/technicians/schedules/services/users, dashboard/report cost-gating, sparepart price stripping for non-admin, service stock reduction. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend: Playwright end-to-end validated admin login, dashboard cost card + monthly cost chart visible; machine create+delete via UI; spareparts price column and 'Menipis' badge visible for admin; export-pdf and BAP pdf buttons clickable without errors; Users page reachable. User login shows role 'User (Lihat Saja)', cost card hidden, nav-users hidden, /users route redirects to /dashboard, spareparts has no Harga column and no add button, repairs has no add button but pdf-service buttons still available, reports export-pdf visible and Biaya column hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' but server.py hardcodes allow_origins from FRONTEND_URL - CORS_ORIGINS env is unused; either remove or wire it up.
login_attempts document upserts locked_until on every failed attempt including counts <5, effectively rolling the lock window; consider only setting locked_until when count reaches MAX_ATTEMPTS.
seed_admin does not reset token_version when password changes on existing admin - old JWTs remain valid until natural expiry.
Cookies are set with secure=True and samesite='none' unconditionally - fine for the HTTPS preview but will break local http:// development.
@app.on_event('startup') and 'shutdown' are deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler.
